title: Installation of the Auxiliary Power Unit Firewall Panel and Compartment Drain Flow Check

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the auxiliary power unit firewall panel, including the joint sealing, the fastener torque sequence and the compartment drain flow check that must pass before the unit is started.

sections.purpose: This task installs the firewall panel in the auxiliary power unit compartment, restores the fire barrier and confirms that the compartment drains correctly.
sections.job_setup_note: The panel is a fire barrier and the joint seal is part of it, so the sealant must be applied and cured under the conditions given in the instructions. Do not start the auxiliary power unit before the cure period is complete, even if every fastener is torqued. The drain flow check is the acceptance test and it must be done with the aircraft at its normal ground attitude.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the auxiliary power unit is shut down and that the fire bottle is safetied. 2. Clean the frame land and remove all traces of the old seal. 3. Do a detailed visual inspection of the frame land and confirm that no corrosion remains. 4. Apply the protection scheme to all bare material and let it dry. 5. Install the seal at FIN 9606PB and check that the joint is continuous with no gap at the corners. CAUTION: A GAP AT A CORNER OF THE SEAL WILL WICK FLUID INTO THE FASTENER HOLES AND THE CORROSION WILL RETURN WITHIN A YEAR. 6. Lift the panel D4910114423015 into position on the support frame. 7. Install the anchor nuts AGS522879K5 and the fasteners in their recorded positions, hand tight. 8. Torque the fasteners in the sequence given on drawing D49101112590, in two stages. 9. Install the cowl latch D4910112220209 and check that it closes with the correct over-centre. 10. Connect the drain line at the clamp D4910115671824 and remove the label. 11. Inspect and refit the heat shield at FIN 633PB. 12. Let the sealant cure for the full period given in the instructions. WARNING: DO NOT START THE AUXILIARY POWER UNIT BEFORE THE SEALANT CURE PERIOD IS COMPLETE. THE FIRE BARRIER IS NOT ESTABLISHED UNTIL THE SEAL HAS CURED. 13. Pour the test quantity of water into the compartment at the position given in the instructions and confirm that it leaves through the drain mast within the stated time. 14. Do an auxiliary power unit ground run and check the compartment for leakage.
sections.close_out: Close the compartment doors and confirm the latch engagement. Remove the fire bottle safety and record the removal. Clear the technical log entry raised at removal. Record the drain flow time; it is the acceptance evidence for the installation.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Drain flow time limit differs pre and post MOD-152210.

safety_precautions: Safety the fire bottle before entry.
Do not start the auxiliary power unit before the cure period is complete.
Apply the protection scheme to all bare material before assembly.
